description: Turns a Markdown document into a PDF without a template, e.g. a report, notes or an answer you wrote, and returns the render with status and download_url. It reads GitHub Flavored Markdown (tables, task lists, strikethrough) and footnotes; a YAML front matter block gives the title, author, subject and keywords, else the first heading is the title; a line \newpage starts a new page. Raw HTML in the text is shown as text. A picture named without an address (![Logo](logo.png)) is a file of the workspace library, uploaded in Formfeed; with path, a picture beside the file is sent along instead. The headings become the PDF bookmarks by default, and pdf_ua checks the file against PDF/UA-1 before it is delivered. If the text holds formulas ($…$, $$…$$ or a ```math fence), set math: they are typeset with KaTeX, and a formula that does not parse fails the call naming its line; without math a $ is text, as in prices. If it holds ```mermaid fences, set diagrams: they are drawn by Mermaid; give each an accTitle line, its name in the PDF, and a diagram that cannot be drawn fails the call naming its line. To fill a template with data, use render; to convert an office file, use convert_to_pdf. Every call is a new render: one unit per started five pages on a live key or for a signed-in agent, free with a test key; every plan.

css.description: A stylesheet after the theme, e.g. h1 { color: #0f766e }; the document is inside div.ff-markdown

diagrams.description: Draws ```mermaid fences with Mermaid (flowcharts, sequences, pie charts and more). Set it when you wrote one, with an accTitle line as its name; left out, a fence prints as code

filename.description: Name of the PDF behind download_url, e.g. report.pdf

markdown.description: The document as Markdown text, up to 1 MB; pass this or path

math.description: Typesets formulas with KaTeX: $…$ and $`…`$ in a line, $$…$$ on lines of their own, ```math fences. Set it when you wrote formulas; left out, a $ stays text

outline.description: Bookmarks from the headings (default true); they cost nothing

paper.description: Paper size; A4 when left out

path.description: Absolute path of a Markdown file on this machine; pictures inside its folder are sent along

pdf_ua.description: Makes the file a PDF/UA-1 document checked by veraPDF; a file that fails is not delivered and the result names the rules

theme.description: document (default) styles the text, in the brand kit fonts and colour where the workspace has one; none leaves the styling to css

title.description: The PDF title; left out, the front matter title or the first heading

wait.description: true waits for a render that continues in the background; false returns it as it is, to check later with get_render

name: markdown_to_pdf

accessibility.description: The PDF/UA-1 verdict, when the template declares it

download_url.description: Signed link to the file; null until the render succeeded

einvoice.description: The e-invoice report, when the render made one

expires_at.description: When download_url stops working; get_render issues a fresh one

form.description: What fill_pdf_form did: the fields filled, those left out (unknown name or invalid value) and those whose calculation or display format no viewer ran

output.description: The format of the file: pdf, png, jpg, webp, docx or pptx, or zip for the several files of split_pdf and pdf_to_image

pdfa.description: The PDF/A verdict (PDF/A-2b or PDF/A-3b), when the template declares it

template.description: The template and version rendered; null for html and conversions

title: Turn Markdown into a PDF
